Name: Heartbeats
Description: Every heartbeat as an event, for heartbeat-evoked potentials: the R-peaks of the ECG channel found exactly as spectHR finds them (the ECG turned upright if inverted, a 0.5 Hz high-pass, peaks above the median plus 1.5 SD at least 300 ms apart, placed to a fraction of a sample), each an event with its interval to the next beat and its heart rate. The data are not changed. Choose the heartbeats per condition with DefineBins, then Average. Continuous data only.
